catalog.notes: The active podium-member projection has one row per medal and a person-first lookup index.
Attempt values are available, but the daily schema has no published solve-grain table.
The person-first primary key supports event coverage aggregation without scanning raw results.
Record codes and dates exist, but there is no record-period or standing-record index.
World-record codes can be counted, but a record-code access path is not materialized.
Attempt values include successes and DNFs; streak semantics still need a product definition.
A thresholded solve count is computable, but Sub-X needs an event and threshold policy.
Year/event/cohort/position browse indexes can restrict to the top 100 before grouping by person.
Current result facts cover value ordering, but each as-of date still requires a historical window rank.

attemptFacts.name: attempt-facts-shared-vs-separate
attemptFacts.stageSql:
SELECT
    facts.result_id,
    facts.event_id,
    facts.person_id,
    facts.competition_id,
    facts.competition_year,
    facts.competition_start_date,
    facts.round_type_id,
    attempt.attempt_number,
    attempt.value AS solve_value
  FROM result_facts facts
  STRAIGHT_JOIN result_attempts attempt ON attempt.result_id = facts.result_id

historical.name: historical-record-and-as-of-ranking-stages
historical.stageSql:
SELECT result_id, event_id, person_id, competition_start_date,
      best, average, regional_single_record, regional_average_record
    FROM result_facts
    WHERE best > 0 OR average > 0

table.attached_condition: standing.result_value > 0 and standing.result_value is not null

conclusions.dailyBuildPolicy: Do not add any proposed statistic to the production projection registry from this experiment.
conclusions.attemptStage: Compare sharedTotalMs with separateTotalMs; a shared stage is not a win if its materialization plus repeated consumers is slower or adds large persistent storage pressure.
conclusions.historicalStages: Treat as-of rankings and standing-record history as lazy or batch-only until a bounded snapshot design beats repeated full result-fact scans.
conclusions.productValueGate: Only promote a candidate after a product owner confirms the use case and the measured incremental build cost is acceptable.
